summary: GenerateCourse is a user control for managing correspondence generation in an academic scheduling or placement system. It allows users to select departments, programs, and terms, filter by status, set output formats, and manage addressee details, signatory information, and CC options for correspondence related to courses and cohorts.
purpose: To enable staff users to generate recipient lists and correspondence for student/course placements, including filtering, formatting, and including various actors and roles in the communication process. It supports multiple correspondence output types and complex inclusion/exclusion rules for programs, courses, and terms.

workflows.name: Correspondence Generation
steps: User selects department, program, and term.
Status filters are set via cklStatus.
Correspondence details and signatory info are provided.
Output format is selected (PDF, MultiPDF, RTF, XLS, TXT, LABEL).
Addressee and CC options are configured (Course Leader, Instructor, Preceptor, Student, Service/Destination Contact).
Correspondence date and ordering fields are set.
System assembles correspondence run variables into a hashtable.
System writes correspondence run variables to database.
CorrespondenceRecipientsPopup window is triggered with relevant parameters.

workflows.name: Dynamic Dropdown Data Population
steps: On department selection, programs are filtered and dropdown populated.
On program selection or page load, terms are filtered and dropdown populated.
On term selection, choosers and cohort/course inclusion list are populated.
Date source dropdown is populated based on cohort/course and schedule.

business_rules: Output format (PDF, MultiPDF, RTF, XLS, TXT, LABEL) must be selected.
Correspondence date must be valid and formatted according to system language settings.
Recipient list must be present unless Outbox mode allows empty (-1).
Department/program/term dropdowns are disabled if provided by querystring (for locked cohort/course scheduling).
Addressee ordering only applies if blank addressee not selected.
FormalLetter disables some UI components (like XLS output, formal letter span).
CC/Actor checkboxes set inclusion in correspondence.
Validation errors are surfaced in UserSession.Messages.
validations: Date validation: txtCorDate must parse and not be null.
Recipient presence: txtRequestDestID must not be '-1' or empty unless Outbox.
Ordering fields are only used if addressee not blank.
Dropdowns only enabled if not set by query parameters.
calculations: Correspondence date formatting based on system language.
Included courses/PRs assembled from CohortID/CourseID or UCchoosers.IncludedList.
conditions: If Outbox, specific PR-related logic and date calculation applies.
Locked cohort/course disables program/term dropdowns and choosers.
Email visibility depends on user role and department permissions.
system_behavior: Populates dropdowns for department, program, and term based on user session and query parameters.
Loads correspondence run variables into database.
Sets up JavaScript variables for client-side logic based on control values and state.
Opens CorrespondenceRecipientsPopup with parameters encoded in URL.
Handles postback and data binding dynamically.
Validation errors shown in UI via UserSession.Messages.
dependencies: UserSession for permissions, agency, user variables, session hash.
Dropdown utility for extracting selected IDs.
DateFormatter for parsing and formatting dates.
Departments, Programs, Terms data sources for dropdowns.
CorrespondenceDetails and CorrespondenceCohortSchedules for schedule and details retrieval.
exceptions: No departments, programs, or terms found.
Signature image staff ID not found if formal letter is not required.
content_gaps: No explicit documentation of UI layout or visual appearance.
Some details about error handling and session security are inferred from code, not described.
Actor roles/permissions logic is not fully mapped to all possible business scenarios.
Specifics for the correspondence output formatting (letter templates, PDF styling, etc.) are not described.
No example values or screenshots included.
